title: The four-arc rectangle: boundary loops, sign windings, and interior zeros

blocks.tex:
Two ingredients are needed and are supplied here.

\begin{enumerate}
  \item A \emph{canonical} boundary parameterization
    (\texttt{FourArcRectangle.lean}).  The rectangle boundary is traversed
    counterclockwise from the midpoint of the right face, and the four faces
    occupy exactly the four arcs cut at $\tfrac18,\tfrac38,\tfrac58,\tfrac78$
    of the parameter interval.  Fixing this convention once is what lets the
    sign hypotheses in the second file be stated as four clean arc conditions.
  \item A \emph{sign-to-winding} lemma
    (\texttt{CrossedFourArcWinding.lean}).  If a loop's four arcs lie in the
    lower, left, right and upper open half-planes respectively --- the
    \emph{crossed} pattern, in which opposite arcs are on opposite sides ---
    then the loop misses the origin and has winding number exactly $1$.
\end{enumerate}

The chapter also collects four compactness lemmas used to make such an
argument survive a perturbation parameter $\varepsilon$: they turn ``positive
at every zero of the $\varepsilon=0$ slice'' into ``uniformly positive for all
small $\varepsilon$''.

\medskip

blocks.title: The standard square boundary

blocks.label: def:fad_square_x
blocks.title: abscissa of the standard square loop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcSquareX
lean.code:
def fourArcSquareX (t : unitInterval) : ℝ :=
  max (-1) (min 1 (|8 * (t : ℝ) - 4| - 2))

blocks.label: def:fad_square_y
blocks.title: ordinate of the standard square loop

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcSquareY
lean.code:
def fourArcSquareY (t : unitInterval) : ℝ :=
  max (-1) (min 1 (max (2 - |8 * (t : ℝ) - 2|) (8 * (t : ℝ) - 8)))

blocks.tex:
Together $(X,Y)$ traverse $\partial[-1,1]^2$ once counterclockwise starting at
$(1,0)$: the right face on $[0,\tfrac18]\cup[\tfrac78,1]$, the top face on
$[\tfrac18,\tfrac38]$, the left face on $[\tfrac38,\tfrac58]$, the bottom face
on $[\tfrac58,\tfrac78]$.

blocks.label: lem:fad_square_cont
blocks.title: the square loop is continuous

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.continuous_fourArcSquareX
lean.code:
lemma continuous_fourArcSquareX : Continuous fourArcSquareX := by
  unfold fourArcSquareX
  fun_prop

lean.code:
lemma fourArcSquareX_mem_Icc (t : unitInterval) :
    fourArcSquareX t ∈ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by
  constructor
  · exact le_max_left _ _
  · exact max_le (by norm_num) (min_le_left _ _)

The outer $\max(-1,\cdot)$ gives the lower bound; the inner $\min(1,\cdot)$

blocks.label: lem:fad_faces_closed
blocks.title: the four closed faces
blocks.body:
$X(t)=1$ for $t\le\tfrac18$ or $t\ge\tfrac78$; $Y(t)=1$ for
  $\tfrac18\le t\le\tfrac38$; $X(t)=-1$ for $\tfrac38\le t\le\tfrac58$;
  $Y(t)=-1$ for $\tfrac58\le t\le\tfrac78$
  ($\mathrm{fourArcSquareY\_eq\_one\_of\_top}$,
  $\mathrm{fourArcSquareX\_eq\_neg\_one\_of\_left}$,
  $\mathrm{fourArcSquareY\_eq\_neg\_one\_of\_bottom}$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcSquareX_eq_one_of_right
lean.code:
lemma fourArcSquareX_eq_one_of_right {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ)) :
    fourArcSquareX t = 1 := by
  rcases ht with ht | ht
  · unfold fourArcSquareX
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith [t.2.1])]
    rw [min_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_right (by norm_num)]
  · unfold fourArcSquareX
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    rw [min_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_right (by norm_num)]

blocks.tex:
On each of the four parameter ranges the inner expression saturates its
  clamp: e.g.\ for $t\le\tfrac18$ one has $|8t-4|-2 = 2-8t \ge 1$, so the
  $\min$ returns $1$ and the $\max$ leaves it.

blocks.label: lem:fad_faces_open
blocks.title: the four open faces avoid the far edge
blocks.body:
On the \emph{open} right arc ($t\le\tfrac18$ or $t>\tfrac78$) one has
  $Y(t)>-1$; and cyclically for the other three arcs
  ($\mathrm{neg\_one\_lt\_fourArcSquareX\_of\_top}$,
  $\mathrm{fourArcSquareY\_lt\_one\_of\_left}$,
  $\mathrm{fourArcSquareX\_lt\_one\_of\_bottom}$).

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.neg_one_lt_fourArcSquareY_of_right
lean.code:
lemma neg_one_lt_fourArcSquareY_of_right {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ)) :
    -1 < fourArcSquareY t := by
  rcases ht with ht | ht
  · unfold fourArcSquareY
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
    rw [show 2 - -(8 * (t : ℝ) - 2) = 8 * (t : ℝ) by ring]
    have hinner : max (8 * (t : ℝ)) (8 * (t : ℝ) - 8) = 8 * (t : ℝ) :=
      max_eq_left (by linarith)
    rw [hinner, min_eq_right (by linarith), max_eq_right (by linarith [t.2.1])]
    norm_num at ht ⊢
    linarith [t.2.1]
  · unfold fourArcSquareY
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    rw [show 2 - (8 * (t : ℝ) - 2) = 4 - 8 * (t : ℝ) by ring]
    have hinner : max (4 - 8 * (t : ℝ)) (8 * (t : ℝ) - 8) =
        8 * (t : ℝ) - 8 := max_eq_right (by linarith)
    rw [hinner, min_eq_right (by linarith [t.2.2]), max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    norm_num at ht ⊢
    linarith

blocks.tex:
Each is a strict inequality between the clamped affine expression and the
  opposite clamp value; the endpoint at which equality would hold is exactly
  the excluded corner of the arc.

blocks.title: Rectangle boundaries

blocks.label: def:fad_rect_boundary
blocks.title: canonical rectangle boundary loop
blocks.body:
For $u_1,u_2,v_1,v_2$ the loop
  $t\mapsto\bigl(\mathrm{mid}(u_1,u_2;X(t)),\ \mathrm{mid}(v_1,v_2;Y(t))\bigr)$,
  where $\mathrm{mid}(a,b;s)$ is the affine reparameterization of $[-1,1]$
  onto $[a,b]$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcRectangleBoundary
lean.code:
noncomputable def fourArcRectangleBoundary
    (u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ) : C(unitInterval, ℝ × ℝ) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦
      ((u₁ + u₂) / 2 + (u₂ - u₁) / 2 * fourArcSquareX t,
        (v₁ + v₂) / 2 + (v₂ - v₁) / 2 * fourArcSquareY t),
    (continuous_const.add
      (continuous_const.mul continuous_fourArcSquareX)).prodMk
      (continuous_const.add
        (continuous_const.mul continuous_fourArcSquareY))⟩

lean.code:
lemma fourArcRectangleBoundary_fst_eq_right
    (u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ) {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ)) :
    (fourArcRectangleBoundary u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ t).1 = u₂ := by
  simp only [fourArcRectangleBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk]

blocks.label: lem:fad_rect_open_faces
blocks.title: strict interiority on open arcs
blocks.body:
If $v_1<v_2$ then the second coordinate is $>v_1$ on the open right arc; and

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcRectangleBoundary_snd_gt_bottom_of_right
lean.code:
lemma fourArcRectangleBoundary_snd_gt_bottom_of_right
    {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ} (hv : v₁ < v₂) {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ)) :
    v₁ < (fourArcRectangleBoundary u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ t).2 := by
  have hy := neg_one_lt_fourArcSquareY_of_right ht
  have hprod : 0 < (v₂ - v₁) * (1 + fourArcSquareY t) :=
    mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hv) (by linarith)
  simp only [fourArcRectangleBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
  nlinarith

blocks.label: lem:fad_rect_mem
blocks.title: the loop stays in the closed rectangle
blocks.body:
If $u_1\le u_2$ and $v_1\le v_2$ then the boundary loop takes values in
  $[u_1,u_2]\times[v_1,v_2]$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcRectangleBoundary_mem
lean.code:
theorem fourArcRectangleBoundary_mem
    {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ} (hu : u₁ ≤ u₂) (hv : v₁ ≤ v₂)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    fourArcRectangleBoundary u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ t ∈
      Set.Icc u₁ u₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc v₁ v₂ := by
  have hx := fourArcSquareX_mem_Icc t
  have hy := fourArcSquareY_mem_Icc t
  have hdu : 0 ≤ u₂ - u₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr hu
  have hdv : 0 ≤ v₂ - v₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr hv
  have hxlo : 0 ≤ (u₂ - u₁) * (1 + fourArcSquareX t) :=
    mul_nonneg hdu (by linarith [hx.1])
  have hxhi : 0 ≤ (u₂ - u₁) * (1 - fourArcSquareX t) :=
    mul_nonneg hdu (by linarith [hx.2])
  have hylo : 0 ≤ (v₂ - v₁) * (1 + fourArcSquareY t) :=
    mul_nonneg hdv (by linarith [hy.1])
  have hyhi : 0 ≤ (v₂ - v₁) * (1 - fourArcSquareY t) :=
    mul_nonneg hdv (by linarith [hy.2])
  constructor
  · constructor <;>
      simp only [fourArcRectangleBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk] <;>
      nlinarith
  · constructor <;>
      simp only [fourArcRectangleBoundary, ContinuousMap.coe_mk] <;>
      nlinarith

blocks.label: def:fad_boundary_map
blocks.title: restricting a map to the boundary loop
blocks.body:
Given $F$ continuous on the closed rectangle, the composite
  $t\mapsto F(\mathrm{boundary}(t))$, packaged as a continuous map on the unit
  interval.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.fourArcRectangleBoundaryMap
lean.code:
noncomputable def fourArcRectangleBoundaryMap
    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ}
    (F : ℝ × ℝ → α) (hu : u₁ ≤ u₂) (hv : v₁ ≤ v₂)
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc u₁ u₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc v₁ v₂)) :
    C(unitInterval, α) :=
  ⟨fun t ↦ F (fourArcRectangleBoundary u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ t),
    hF.comp_continuous (fourArcRectangleBoundary u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂).continuous
      (fourArcRectangleBoundary_mem hu hv)⟩

theorem fourArcRectangleBoundaryMap_zero_eq_one
    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ}
    (F : ℝ × ℝ → α) (hu : u₁ ≤ u₂) (hv : v₁ ≤ v₂)

    fourArcRectangleBoundaryMap F hu hv hF 0 =
      fourArcRectangleBoundaryMap F hu hv hF 1 := by
  simp [fourArcRectangleBoundaryMap]

blocks.title: Crossed four-arc signs force winding one

blocks.label: def:fad_crossed_pattern
blocks.title: crossed four-arc sign pattern
blocks.body:
A loop $\gamma$ in $\mathbb{C}$ has the \emph{crossed four-arc signs} when
  \begin{align*}
    \Im\gamma(t)&<0 &&\text{for } t\le\tfrac18 \text{ or } \tfrac78<t,\\
    \Re\gamma(t)&<0 &&\text{for } \tfrac18\le t<\tfrac38,\\
    \Re\gamma(t)&>0 &&\text{for } \tfrac38<t\le\tfrac58,\\
    \Im\gamma(t)&>0 &&\text{for } \tfrac58\le t<\tfrac78,
  \end{align*}
  together with the two corner conditions $\Im\gamma(\tfrac38)<0$ and
  $\Re\gamma(\tfrac78)<0$.

blocks.label: thm:fad_ne_zero
blocks.title: crossed signs exclude the origin
blocks.body: A loop with the crossed four-arc signs is nowhere zero.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.ne_zero_of_crossed_fourArcs
lean.code:
theorem ne_zero_of_crossed_fourArcs
    (gamma : C(unitInterval, ℂ))
    (hright : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      ((t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ)) → (gamma t).im < 0)
    (htop : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      1 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) < 3 / 8 → (gamma t).re < 0)
    (hleft : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      3 / 8 < (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 8 → 0 < (gamma t).re)
    (hbottom : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      5 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) < 7 / 8 → 0 < (gamma t).im)
    (htopLeft : ∀ t : unitInterval, (t : ℝ) = 3 / 8 → (gamma t).im < 0)
    (hbottomRight : ∀ t : unitInterval, (t : ℝ) = 7 / 8 → (gamma t).re < 0) :
    ∀ t, gamma t ≠ 0 := by
  intro t hzero
  have hre : (gamma t).re = 0 := by simpa using congrArg Complex.re hzero
  have him : (gamma t).im = 0 := by simpa using congrArg Complex.im hzero
  by_cases h1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8
  · linarith [hright t (Or.inl h1)]
  by_cases h3 : (t : ℝ) < 3 / 8
  · linarith [htop t (by linarith) h3]
  by_cases he3 : (t : ℝ) = 3 / 8
  · linarith [htopLeft t he3]
  have ht3 : 3 / 8 < (t : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h3) (Ne.symm he3)
  by_cases h5 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 8
  · linarith [hleft t ht3 h5]
  by_cases h7 : (t : ℝ) < 7 / 8
  · linarith [hbottom t (by linarith) h7]
  by_cases he7 : (t : ℝ) = 7 / 8
  · linarith [hbottomRight t he7]
  · have ht7 : 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ) :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt h7) (Ne.symm he7)
    linarith [hright t (Or.inr ht7)]

deps.title: crossed four-arc sign pattern
deps.label: def:fad_crossed_pattern

blocks.tex:
Every parameter lies in one of the four arcs, and on each the corresponding
  strict inequality forbids the value $0$; the two corner hypotheses cover the
  two parameters $\tfrac38$ and $\tfrac78$ at which the arc conditions
  constrain only the coordinate that is allowed to vanish there.

blocks.label: thm:fad_winding_one
blocks.title: crossed signs give winding number one
blocks.body:
A nowhere-zero loop $\gamma$ with $\gamma(0)=\gamma(1)$ and the crossed
  four-arc signs has $\mathrm{windingNumberC}\,\gamma = 1$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.windingNumberC_eq_one_of_crossed_fourArcs
lean.code:
theorem windingNumberC_eq_one_of_crossed_fourArcs
    (gamma : C(unitInterval, ℂ)) (hgamma : ∀ t, gamma t ≠ 0)
    (hloop : gamma 0 = gamma 1)
    (hright : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      ((t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 8 ∨ 7 / 8 < (t : ℝ)) → (gamma t).im < 0)
    (htop : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      1 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) < 3 / 8 → (gamma t).re < 0)
    (hleft : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      3 / 8 < (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 8 → 0 < (gamma t).re)
    (hbottom : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      5 / 8 ≤ (t : ℝ) → (t : ℝ) < 7 / 8 → 0 < (gamma t).im)
    (htopLeft : ∀ t : unitInterval, (t : ℝ) = 3 / 8 → (gamma t).im < 0)
    (hbottomRight : ∀ t : unitInterval, (t : ℝ) = 7 / 8 → (gamma t).re < 0) :
    Gluck.windingNumberC gamma hgamma = 1 := by
  let H : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, ℂ) :=
    ⟨fun st ↦ crossedFourArcModel st.2 +
      (st.1 : ℝ) • (gamma st.2 - crossedFourArcModel st.2), by fun_prop⟩
  have hH : ∀ st, H st ≠ 0 := fun st ↦ crossed_four_arc_line_homotopy_ne_aux
    gamma hright htop hleft hbottom htopLeft hbottomRight st.1 st.2
  have hzero : ∀ t, H (0, t) = crossedFourArcModel t := by
    intro t
    simp [H]
  have hone : ∀ t, H (1, t) = gamma t := by
    intro t
    simp [H]
  have hHloop : ∀ s, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    simp only [H, ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    rw [crossed_four_arc_model_loop_aux, hloop]
  have hwind := Gluck.windingNumberC_eq_of_homotopy crossedFourArcModel gamma
    crossed_four_arc_model_ne_aux hgamma H hH hzero hone hHloop
  exact hwind ▸ crossed_four_arc_model_winding_aux

deps.title: Origin-centered winding
deps.label: def:discrete_winding_number_c

deps.title: crossed signs exclude the origin
deps.label: thm:fad_ne_zero

blocks.tex:
Compare $\gamma$ with the explicit model loop
  $M(t) = e^{\,i\varphi(t)}$, where $\varphi$ is the piecewise-affine phase
  \[
    \varphi(t) = \tfrac{9\pi}{8} + \pi t + 2\pi\max\bigl(0,\min(t-\tfrac38,\tfrac12)\bigr),
  \]
  which is $\tfrac{9\pi}{8}+\pi t$ for $t\le\tfrac38$, then
  $\tfrac{3\pi}{8}+3\pi t$ on $[\tfrac38,\tfrac78]$, then
  $\tfrac{17\pi}{8}+\pi t$.  Its total increase is
  $\varphi(1)-\varphi(0) = 2\pi$, so $M$ has winding number $1$; the model
  visits the four arcs with exactly the crossed signs, and the two designated
  corners with the designated signs.

  The comparison is a straight-line homotopy.  On each arc, $\gamma$ and $M$
  satisfy the \emph{same} strict half-plane inequality, and a half-plane is
  convex and misses the origin, so $(1-s)\gamma(t)+sM(t)$ is nonzero for every
  $s$.  At the two corner parameters the corner hypotheses supply the missing
  half-plane.  Hence the homotopy is zero-free, and since winding is a
  homotopy invariant of zero-free loops, $\gamma$ and $M$ have the same
  winding number.

blocks.title: Interior zeros

blocks.label: thm:fad_exists_zero
blocks.title: nonzero winding forces an interior zero
blocks.body:
Let $u_1<u_2$, $v_1<v_2$ and let $F$ be continuous on the closed rectangle.
  If the boundary loop of $F$ is nowhere zero and has nonzero winding number,
  then $F$ has a zero in the \emph{open} rectangle.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.exists_zero_of_fourArcRectangleBoundary_winding
lean.code:
theorem exists_zero_of_fourArcRectangleBoundary_winding
    {u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ : ℝ} (hu : u₁ < u₂) (hv : v₁ < v₂)
    {F : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ}
    (hF : ContinuousOn F (Set.Icc u₁ u₂ ×ˢ Set.Icc v₁ v₂))
    (gamma : C(unitInterval, ℂ)) (hgamma : ∀ t, gamma t ≠ 0)
    (hgammaEq : ∀ t, gamma t =
      F (fourArcRectangleBoundary u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂ t))
    (hwind : Gluck.windingNumberC gamma hgamma ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z ∈ Set.Ioo u₁ u₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo v₁ v₂, F z = 0 := by
  by_contra hnot
  push Not at hnot
  exact hwind (windingNumberC_eq_zero_of_no_interior_zero_aux
    hu hv hF gamma hgamma hgammaEq hnot)

deps.label: def:discrete_winding_number_c

deps.title: restricting a map to the boundary loop
deps.label: def:fad_boundary_map

blocks.tex:
Suppose $F$ has no zero in the open rectangle.  Contract the boundary loop
  radially towards the centre $c = \bigl(\tfrac{u_1+u_2}2,\tfrac{v_1+v_2}2\bigr)$:
  \[
    H(s,t) = (1-s)\,c + s\cdot\mathrm{boundary}(t) .
  \]
  Because the rectangle is a product of intervals, $H(s,t)$ lies in the
  \emph{open} rectangle for every $s<1$ and on the boundary at $s=1$.  Hence
  $F\circ H$ is zero-free: for $s<1$ by the assumption, at $s=1$ by the
  hypothesis on the boundary loop.  It is a homotopy of loops from the
  constant loop at $F(c)$ to the boundary loop, so the two have equal winding
  numbers; the constant one is $0$, contradicting the hypothesis.
